stocktwits.name: Skydance Corp. - Ordinary Shares - Class B
stocktwits.why: SKYDs sharp post-earnings selloff is driving discussion, with traders focused on the heavy debt from the Warner Bros. Discovery merger, dilution risk and uncertainty about whether promised cost savings can offset the burden. Bulls call the shares undervalued and point to potential synergies, while some blame short sellers; talk of a SpaceX partnership remains speculative.

stocktwits.name: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd
stocktwits.why: Alibabas Apex subsidiary being placed on the U.S. trade blacklist has renewed concern that export restrictions could limit chip access and weigh on its AI and cloud ambitions. Traders are split between seeing the restrictions and recent earnings concerns as further risks, and arguing that strong cloud growth and the stocks low valuation support a bullish case.

stocktwits.name: Insmed Inc
stocktwits.why: Reports that Sanofi is weighing a takeover of Insmed have driven the dominant discussion, with traders debating possible offer terms and whether other pharmaceutical companies could emerge as bidders. The acquisition remains unconfirmed, and some traders are also weighing the takeover speculation against Insmeds commercial growth and pipeline prospects.

stocktwits.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co
stocktwits.why: HPEs strong quarterly results and raised full-year outlook are drawing attention, but shares fell after the report as traders focused on margin pressure from memory and component costs and a near-term outlook that missed the most optimistic expectations. Bulls point to continued AI infrastructure demand and the buyback, while others see the post-earnings drop as a warning about profitability.

stocktwits.name: Redwire Corp
stocktwits.why: Redwires rebound is drawing attention after CEO Peter Cannito disclosed another share purchase, even as Mizuho initiated coverage with an Underperform rating. Traders are weighing the insider buying, record backlog and recent contract wins against concerns about execution, backlog conversion and cash flow.

stocktwits.name: BitMine Immersion Technologies Inc
stocktwits.why: Ethereums decline is pressuring BitMines ETH-heavy treasury and fueling bearish commentary. Traders are also questioning managements capital allocationespecially the lack of buybacks and an undisclosed moonshot investmentwhile some see the discount to asset value as an opportunity if ETH rebounds.

stocktwits.name: Modine Manufacturing Co.
stocktwits.why: Reported Samsung talks to acquire Modine have sparked a sharp rally, though no deal or terms are confirmed. Traders are split between anticipating a substantial takeover premium and warning that the rumor-driven gain could fade; the companys data-center cooling growth and investor-day outlook also feature in the bullish case.

stocktwits.name: iShares Silver Trust
stocktwits.why: SLV is drawing attention amid a steep silver selloff, which traders link to rising Fed rate-hike expectations, a stronger dollar, and broader liquidity pressure. The community is divided between calling the decline an oversold buying opportunity and expecting further losses, with some also alleging manipulation or pointing to premiums on physical silver.

stocktwits.name: Dell Technologies Inc
stocktwits.why: A broad AI-stock rebound following Nvidias reinstatement of Jensen Huang drove DELLs sharp rally as traders positioned ahead of Dells earnings report. Bulls cite AI-server demand, while skeptics question whether rising component costs and thin margins will translate into profits.
